time_handling: Cooling rate uses actual scan-time separation; 1 K over 30 min is the nominal equivalence, not a replacement of the archived rate implementation.
selection: Selected on VALIDATION with minimum nominal absolute cooling of 1 K; the unconstrained 0.1-K validation optimum is not the adopted baseline. TEST was not used to select the threshold.
source: Author-supplied completed CTC30 run output in this session
provenance_scope: Counts transcribed from the completed cluster log supplied by the author; scores recomputed from those counts. Original cluster result-file bytes and cohort hash were not supplied in this update; no source-file checksum is invented.
omitted_fields: CTC mean/median object sizes and gradient diagnostics were not supplied for this revision and remain empty, rather than retaining old values.
